prompt: Your team stamps out identical starter repos: same README, same CI workflow, same ignore file. What is the built-in GitHub feature for this?
explanation: Marking a repository as a template adds a "Use this template" action that starts a brand-new repository from its contents — fresh history, no shared lineage. A fork stays linked to the upstream and carries its history.

options.text: A template repository, whose "Use this template" button creates a fresh repository with the same files
A fork, which copies the repository with its full history
Re-cloning and deleting `.git` by hand every time
